scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof plus a separately reconstructed 45-case exact-rational full moment-system verification; independence and publication priority are not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for linear real phases, finite complete graph, balanced fixed natural frequencies, positive transverse coupling and Poisson zero resets. Does not assert nonlinear circle-valued Kuramoto results, thermal noise, or general graph topology.
title: Exact reset-clock comparison in a balanced complete-graph phase network
